downloadedSourceCountNote: Zero is correct and is the assignment's pinned value. Nothing was downloaded, no issuer was contacted, no file entered version control, no materialization destination was written and no receipt was created. Every measurement below was taken from the bytes this repository already retains and which the adopted edition already manifests source-gated.

method.description: Deterministic in-repository identity reconciliation of the four retained Maryland CC-DC-CR-072 petitions. Each retained binary was opened and measured directly, its printed revision block and caption were read from the form face, and the result was compared against the adopted edition's manifest row, the repository asset audit, the source-acquisition queue and the track-source relationships. No network retrieval, no issuer contact, no legal-design change and no edition mutation were performed.
method.measuredFrom: private/Nationwide Record Clearing/LegalEase Maryland/LegalEase Maryland forms /
method.measuredFromNote: private/ is untracked in a factory worktree but the corpus is unpacked in sibling checkouts. The repository asset audit records these exact four digests with presence=present, binaryPresent=true and hashState=match, and each is an exact SHA-256 match to a retained source_gated edition row. The basis is a retained repository asset, not an acquisition.
method.tooling: poppler (pdfinfo, pdftotext -layout) for document metadata and face text; pdf-lib for the AcroForm, per-page annotation and page-geometry reads
method.assignmentConstraintObserved: The stop condition confines this job to retained repository assets and deterministic identity mapping, with no download, no issuer contact, no legal-design change and no edition edit. Every finding below is derived from retained bytes or retained records. Currentness against the publisher today is expressly NOT asserted — see currentnessBoundary.

finding.headline: All four petitions are present, correctly identified and byte-stable, and the printed revision block on each form face is now read rather than assumed. Three defects surface, none of them an acquisition gap: the edition carries a wrong official title for CC-DC-CR-072C and a lossy one for 072B and 072D, the edition field_count for all four is one lower than the terminal-field count because it silently excludes the Reset pushbutton, and the edition records no page count at all.
finding.acquisitionRequiredRationale: Nothing needs to be obtained from the Maryland Judiciary. All four binaries are retained, all four digests match the adopted edition rows exactly, and all four printed revision blocks are legible on the form face. What blocks these rows is a source gate on currentness plus metadata defects, not a missing file.
finding.sourceGateStatusDetail: The edition records freshness_status=currentness_unconfirmed and required_follow_up 'Confirm the current published revision with the Maryland Judiciary' on all four rows. This job closes the half of that question that can be answered from retained bytes — what revision the retained copy IS — and cannot close the half that requires reading the publisher today, because the assignment forbids downloading.

widgetVersusTerminalFieldDenominator.detail: Every terminal field on all four documents carries exactly one widget, so the widget count and the terminal-field count coincide. Unlike the Illinois FW-CIV case there is no multi-widget field anywhere in this family and no nine-field drift to reconcile.
widgetVersusTerminalFieldDenominator.editionCountDefect: The adopted edition records field_count 46, 47, 51 and 38 for 072A, 072B, 072C and 072D. The measured terminal-field and widget counts are 47, 48, 52 and 39. The difference is exactly one on every document and it is the single PDFButton — the 'Reset' pushbutton printed on each face. The edition denominator therefore counts fillable fields excluding the pushbutton, while both the AcroForm /Fields array and the page /Annots array include it.
widgetVersusTerminalFieldDenominator.consequence: A field map keyed on the edition's 46/47/51/38 and validated against a parsed 47/48/52/39 will misalign by one on all four documents, and the extra entry is a control that must never be written to. Both denominators are recorded here so the ambiguity cannot survive, and the pushbutton is named so a mapper can exclude it deliberately rather than by accident.
widgetVersusTerminalFieldDenominator.pushbuttonMustNotBeMapped: The Reset button clears the form. It is not a data field, must not appear in any field map as writable, and must not be counted toward participant-completed fields.

javaScriptPresentOnAllFour.consequence: Each form carries document-level or field-level JavaScript. No decision exists about what a renderer does with it on fill or flatten. Recorded as an open technical question, not resolved here.

editionMetadataDefects.why: The General Waiver and Release is Maryland Rules Form 4-503.2, a second instrument printed beneath the petition on the same page. The edition has taken the subordinate instrument's name as the document's title, which also propagated into the canonical path slug petition-for-expungement-with-general-waiver-and-release. The distinguishing fact about this document is that fewer than three years have passed, not that a waiver is attached — 072A also contemplates an attached waiver.
editionMetadataDefects.correction: Set official_title to the form-face caption and record the Rules Form 4-503.2 waiver as a printed sub-instrument rather than as the title.

editionMetadataDefects.why: 072B's recorded title drops both qualifiers that make it selectable — non-cannabis and guilty disposition — leaving a name that reads as a generic petition and is indistinguishable from 072A's. 072D's recorded title inverts the issuer's own wording. The two forms are a matched pair distinguished precisely by the cannabis qualifier, and the edition records neither side of the pair using the issuer's language.
editionMetadataDefects.correction: Set both official_title values to the form-face captions.

editionMetadataDefects.why: The face carries a day and a same-day sequence marker. REV-2025-10 preserves neither. The '-2' means the Judiciary issued at least one earlier revision bearing the same 10/01/2025 date, so a month-precision code cannot distinguish this copy from its immediate predecessor. The adopted manifest already uses day-precision codes elsewhere (for example REV-2025-05-08 for the Arizona family), so the precision exists in the vocabulary and was simply not used here.
editionMetadataDefects.correction: Record a revision code that preserves the day and the sequence marker, and keep the verbatim printed block alongside it.
editionMetadataDefects.note: 072A, 072C and 072D carry month-precision faces (09/2025, 01/2025, 10/2025) and their edition codes are exact. This defect is specific to 072B.

currentnessBoundary.whatIsEstablished: What revision each retained copy IS, read from its own printed face, and that each retained copy is byte-identical to the asset the adopted edition manifests.
currentnessBoundary.whatIsNotEstablished: Whether the Maryland Judiciary publishes a newer revision today. The assignment forbids downloading and forbids contacting the issuer, so no publisher comparison was made or attempted.
currentnessBoundary.consequence: freshness_status must remain currentness_unconfirmed on all four rows. This job narrows the follow-up from 'confirm the revision' to 'compare the four named printed revisions against the publisher', which is a one-step check for whoever is authorized to make it.
currentnessBoundary.recordedSourceUrlNotExercised: https://www.mdcourts.gov/legalhelp/expungement is recorded on all four edition rows as source_url. It was not fetched.
currentnessBoundary.doNotInfer: A month-precision face date is not evidence of currentness, and neither is the absence of a newer copy in this repository.

affectedTracksAndComponents.oneDocumentServesTwoTracks: CC-DC-CR-072B serves both md_10110_conviction and md_pardon_expungement. That is correct and must not be split into two documents: the pardon checkbox and the § 10-110 checkboxes are on the same face.
affectedTracksAndComponents.bindingCorrectness: All five component-to-document bindings are correct as they stand. No rebinding is required or performed.

doNotSubstitute.why: Both are favourable-disposition petitions. The distinguishing fact is the three-year clock: 072A is at or beyond three years (or with a waiver attached), 072C is under three years and prints the waiver inline. The edition's title for 072C actively invites this confusion by naming it after the waiver.
A matched pair split solely on cannabis. 072B is expressly non-cannabis; 072D is cannabis. Binding either to the other's track would put a participant's conviction on the wrong statutory route.

sourceMaterializationEligibility.laterMaterializationPermittedDetail: In principle yes: all four assets are adopted with canonical paths, pinned digests and byte counts, so a receipt is mechanical once the source gate clears.
sourceMaterializationEligibility.notPermittedYetDetail: The assets are asset_class=source_gated with freshness_status=currentness_unconfirmed, packet_candidate=no, generation_allowed=no and runtime_status=runtime_disabled. Materializing a source-gated asset would carry an unconfirmed revision into the runtime contract. No receipt was created and none should be until the currentness gate clears.
prerequisitesInOrder: 1. Compare the four printed revisions recorded here against the Maryland Judiciary's current publication, by whoever is authorized to fetch.
2. Apply the edition metadata corrections above.
3. Clear the source gate and reclassify from source_gated to packet_form if the comparison holds.
4. Author receipts pinning the four digests and byte counts recorded here, with destinations under official-pdf/MD/.
5. Seal the materialized files at 0444 with every containing directory at 0555.

implementationFamilyEffect.effectOfThisJob: Four Maryland projection identities move from source_gated_identity with an unread revision and unrecorded structure to fully measured documents with a face-read revision, a complete page geometry, an explicit field denominator and a named title defect. The acquisition question closes for all four without a download.
implementationFamilyEffect.familyReadinessStatement: The Maryland official-PDF family remains fail-closed and this job does not move it. All four rows stay source_gated, packet_candidate=no, generation_allowed=no and runtime_disabled, and the currentness gate stays open because the assignment forbids the comparison that would close it. No packet becomes generatable, no renderer is assigned and no field map is built.
implementationFamilyEffect.rendererObservation: Four single-page unrotated Letter AcroForms with 1:1 field-to-widget mapping, no XFA and no encryption are acroform_fill candidates rather than coordinate-overlay ones. An observation about the artifacts; the lane is not assigned here.
implementationFamilyEffect.fieldMapEffect: None built. The denominator both maps must agree on is recorded, and the Reset pushbutton is named for exclusion.

terminalDispositionDetail.why: The narrowest disposition the evidence supports. It is not unresolved_identity: every document, issuer, role, scope, route and printed revision is established from the artifact itself. It is not acquisition_required: all four binaries are retained and digest-matched. It is not source_gate_cleared, because clearing it requires a publisher comparison this assignment forbids. What the four rows actually need is a metadata correction and one authorized currentness check.

expectedDownstreamEffect: Four Maryland source-gated identities gain a face-read revision, a measured structure and an explicit field denominator, and the acquisition question closes for all four without a download. Five component bindings across five tracks are confirmed correct as they stand. Edition 1.3 receives six concrete metadata corrections, one of which — the 072C title — currently names a subordinate Rules form as the document. The remaining Maryland source-gate work reduces to a single authorized comparison against the publisher. No component is rebound, no receipt is created, no binary enters version control, no renderer is assigned, no memo is edited, no edition is published, no packet becomes generatable, no runtime is enabled and no track changes promotion state.
